text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian missed out on 1st place in 
the Kikuka Sho. She quietly accepts her 
own weakness...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, she refuses to stop in her 
tracks. Believing she can still grow 
stronger, she resolves to train even 
harder.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
By the time they face off at their next 
goal, the Arima Kinen, Hishi Amazon is 
sure to be even stronger...
